theorems.name: Submission.rpn_null_of_compact_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U E : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → μ W < ∞) → MeasurableSet E → (∀ K, IsCompact K → K ⊆ E → K ⊆ U → μ K = 0) → μ E = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
